security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, and financial vocabulary such as cost or short signal. Confirmed risk remains where the skill directs agents to run Longbridge quant scripts server-side and suggests a package installation command. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Remote execution of user-defined indicator scripts
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before sending scripts to Longbridge quant run, and disclose that script text is processed server-side.
Tell agents to ask the user before running pip install commands or modifying the local Python environment.
Add a safety note to validate symbols and arguments before running Longbridge CLI commands from user input.

content.value_statement: Quant research requires consistent market data workflows and disciplined validation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Longbridge-based strategy analysis.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests to workflows for pairs trading, volatility, seasonality, multi-factor models, hedging, execution costs, and ML signals.
Explains how to fetch Longbridge K-line and fundamental data through documented CLI or MCP paths.
Builds factor screens using PE, PB, ROE, growth, dividend yield, and composite scoring.
Frames backtests with walk-forward validation, overfitting checks, slippage, and risk metrics.
Creates indicator script workflows for Longbridge quant run and JSON output review.
limitations: It depends on Longbridge CLI or MCP availability for current market data.
It does not place trades or provide personalized investment advice.
Some Longbridge commands may require installation, authentication, or exact flag checks.
Backtests and factor rankings depend on data quality and selected assumptions.

use_cases.title: Research a Factor Screen
use_cases.description: Define value, quality, growth, and dividend filters, then rank a supplied equity universe.

use_cases.title: Review Portfolio Hedges
use_cases.description: Compare beta hedges, protective puts, collars, and tail-risk instruments with cost estimates.

use_cases.title: Learn Strategy Validation
use_cases.description: Build a clear walk-forward test plan with out-of-sample metrics and overfitting checks.

prompt_templates.title: Screen a Small Universe
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Longbridge data to screen these symbols for value and quality factors. Explain the criteria and rank the results.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Symbols
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze whether TSLA.US and NVDA.US show correlation or cointegration. Include data requirements, tests, and trading caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Build Walk-Forward Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a walk-forward validation plan for a momentum strategy on 700.HK. Include parameters, OOS checks, and risk metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Factor Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-factor model for a regional equity universe. Use IC-weighted factors, turnover controls, and hedge considerations.

output_examples.input: Screen CSI 300 constituents for value and quality.
output_examples.output: A ranked table with valuation, quality, growth, dividend yield, composite score, source notes, and clear caveats.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a pair trade idea for two bank stocks.
output: Hedge ratio, spread signal, and entry or exit thresholds.
Risks, data limits, and non-advice disclaimer.

output_examples.input: Plan a volatility regime strategy for an index ETF.
output_examples.output: A regime framework with historical volatility percentiles, option structure choices, hedge costs, and validation steps.

best_practices: Confirm the market, symbol format, data range, and benchmark before analysis.
Use out-of-sample validation and explain assumptions for every backtest.
Ask before running CLI commands or sending user scripts to Longbridge.
anti_patterns: Treating a high backtest Sharpe ratio as proof of future returns.
Running package installs, CLI calls, or remote script execution without user consent.
Mixing data sources without labeling the source and timestamp.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It supports analysis, screening, strategy design, and validation workflows only.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Some workflows use public CLI data, but specific commands or datasets may require installation or authentication.

faq.question: Can it run indicator scripts?
faq.answer: Yes, it documents Longbridge quant workflows. The agent should ask before sending any script for server-side execution.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. Outputs are research support and should include assumptions, limitations, and source notes.

faq.question: What data sources does it prefer?
faq.answer: It prefers Longbridge data and platform capabilities, with MCP fallback when the CLI is unavailable.
